currentState: Ended by his death. Jaina froze him to the floor and read him as she reads a hostage; she asked him gently, then knelt beside him dead and read him: clean. She carries it as a private guilt ('She had hated doing it to a wolf. And he'd have thawed in the end... waiting.').
powerDynamic: Captor and captive; he has the one thing she needs (who made it); he refuses it: 'I'm not to speak to you.'

physicalDynamics.pattern: He looks at her head coming up out of the stairwell 'a turnip' and then at the blue light; she freezes him by pushing the staff heel to the boards and he makes a 'high thin sound through his nose'; at the cage she leans in so her cheek is almost on the bars with the staff held up; he looks up and his lip bubbles; after he dies she kneels on the stone and reads his gut.

history.event: Loft: frost over him, 'A person made a different sound.'
'Who made it?' / 'I'm not to speak to you.' / 'You don't know what you're keeping them from.'
Cage: gentle question; he dies; his gut is clean.

trajectory: Ended; Jaina's guilt (if she had frozen his jaw) is open.
